description: This file defines the DetailedLeave class, which is part of the Leave Request Data Transfer Objects (DTO) in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It encapsulates detailed information about leave requests, including leave periods, status, balance, allowed actions, and workflows, and provides methods to manipulate and retrieve this data.

classes.name: DetailedLeave
classes.description: This class encapsulates detailed information about a specific leave request, including its status, period, balance, and allowed actions and workflows, providing methods to retrieve and manipulate this data within the OrangeHRM leave management system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a DetailedLeave instance with a specific Leave object.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets cached properties related to the leave details, leaving room for fresh computations.

methods.name: getLeave
methods.description: Returns the Leave object associated with this detailed view.

methods.name: setLeave
methods.description: Sets the Leave object and resets cached properties.

methods.name: setLeaves
methods.description: Sets multiple Leave objects (leaves) for the detailed view.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves the iterable collection of leaves.

methods.name: getDatesDetail
methods.description: Returns detailed date information about the leave request, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getLeaveStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the leave with details like type and length days.

methods.name: getLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the leave balance based on employee, leave type, and period.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Determines and returns the leave period associated with the leave request.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Returns a list of actions (like 'APPROVE', 'REJECT') permitted for this leave request.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Privately retrieves the workflows allowed for a given leave status.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is allowed on this leave request.

methods.name: getWorkflowForAction
methods.description: Returns the workflow state corresponding to a specific action if allowed.
